context: Evaluates correct implementation of the fetchClient from visionarias-client. The client must read a tenant ID from cookies, inject it as an X-Tenant-ID header on every request, handle 401 and 403 responses with appropriate redirects, and pass through all other responses unchanged.

checklist.name: X-Tenant-ID injection
checklist.description: Reads the tenant-id cookie and sets it as the X-Tenant-ID header on the outgoing request

checklist.name: Existing headers preserved
checklist.description: Merges the X-Tenant-ID header with any existing headers in the init parameter without overwriting them

checklist.name: 401 redirect to /sign-in
checklist.description: When fetch returns a response with status 401, sets window.location.href to '/sign-in'

checklist.name: 403 redirect to /forbidden
checklist.description: When fetch returns a response with status 403, sets window.location.href to '/forbidden'

checklist.name: Passthrough for success
checklist.description: Returns the Response object directly for all non-error status codes without modification
